clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Reaches Hazardous Levels Following Deepavali
aiSummaryBullets: The Central Pollution Control Board reported Delhi's air quality index reached severe levels, with some areas exceeding an AQI of 450.
Local government officials have begun deploying water sprinkling measures to help mitigate the impact of the toxic smog.

clusters.headline: Narendra Modi Inaugurates Bengaluru Metro Amidst Political Debates
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the new elevated stretch of the Namma Metro Pink Line during his visit to Bengaluru.
The Prime Minister attended golden jubilee celebrations for Prashanti Kutiram and commemorated the birth centenary of H.V. Sheshadri.

clusters.headline: Political Shifts And Administrative Developments In Tamil Nadu State
aiSummaryBullets: The TVK government faces criticism from opposition parties and allies regarding law and order and coalition management.
Administrative actions include salary hikes for guest lecturers, flood relief, and the prosecution of IAS officers.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Sparks Political Debate And Personal Revelations
aiSummaryBullets: The memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love provides insights into historical political moments, including the 1969 Presidential elections and the 1999 Congress revolt.
Personal anecdotes in the book range from Sonia Gandhi's 1978 visit to Indira Gandhi in Tihar Jail to her reflections on interactions with Pranab Mukherjee.

clusters.headline: Sonam Wangchuk Placed Under House Arrest Amid Ladakh Poll Protests
aiSummaryBullets: Activist Sonam Wangchuk stated he is under house arrest following his removal from a protest site by local police.
Civil society groups are demanding the postponement of Ladakh's hill council elections, citing the harsh winter conditions.

clusters.headline: India Launches New Bengaluru To Madgaon Vande Bharat Express Train
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw officially inaugurated the new Vande Bharat Express service.
The train connects Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Madgaon, operating as part of the nationwide railway network expansion.

clusters.headline: Maharashtra Minister Denies NCP Merger Talks Following Meeting
aiSummaryBullets: Minister Dattatray Bharne stated that a recent encounter with Sunetra Pawar involved no discussions regarding a Nationalist Congress Party merger.
The meeting was reportedly an informal gathering rather than a formal political party session.

clusters.headline: Paytm Receives Reserve Bank Of India Nod For Prepaid Wallet Licence
aiSummaryBullets: Paytm Payments Services secured initial approval from the Reserve Bank of India to provide prepaid payment instruments.
The firm stated it will offer these services to customers following the receipt of final authorization from the central bank.

clusters.headline: Regulatory Body Fines Ola For Misleading Tipping Feature Practices
aiSummaryBullets: The Central Consumer Protection Authority fined Ola 10 lakh rupees for misleading tipping prompts.
The company must discontinue specific messages suggesting tips increase the likelihood of ride confirmation.

clusters.headline: India Invites Pakistan To Attend Inaugural SCO Civilisational Forum
aiSummaryBullets: India will host the first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi from November 20 to 22.
Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat stated that several nations, including China, Kazakhstan, and Iran, have confirmed participation.
